title: MaterialDNA canonical semantic-key grammar
objective: Close the already-demonstrated MaterialDNA canonical-key alias where validateProjectKey accepts '%' even though the declared stable semantic-key alphabet is [a-z0-9._/-], without changing material identity, schema versions, fixtures, or Roblox-facing architecture.
acceptance: validateProjectKey rejects '%' so the accepted implementation matches the documented lowercase stable-key alphabet [a-z0-9._/-]
the rejection applies through every MaterialDNA field that delegates to validateProjectKey, including recipe IDs, coherence classes, nested semantic keys, state recipeId, and MaterialRef id
add deterministic regression coverage using at least one URI-percent-style key such as materials%2fcarpet and preserve ordinary slash-containing project keys
preserve all shipped MaterialFixtureCatalog IDs, recipeVersion values, exact fixture content seals, and MaterialDNA.SchemaVersion
do not introduce a second material identity, migration framework, renderer/asset adapter, or Studio dependency
inherit the accepted repairCount exactness and bounded-validator behavior from predecessor MaterialDNA lanes rather than reconstructing them
canonical CI, live ownership after control recovery, and fresh independent exact-head review are required before integration
notes: Operationalizes historical finding evt-20260811-081620-mat8c3r1-materialdna-key-grammar, whose audited immutable blob already demonstrated that validateProjectKey uses ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._/%-]*$ while its diagnostic/documented alphabet excludes '%'. That event could not safely be generalized by the control validator because its legacy affects payload included a non-lane descriptor, but its exact audited evidence remains useful. This lane is deliberately PROPOSED and sequenced after HG-BACKFILL-MATERIALDNA-DENSE-BOUNDS so the two leaves cannot overlap edits to MaterialDNA.luau; the bounded-validation leaf is higher priority.
